author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on canonical workspace propagation. The 'Clone is cheap because JmapClient is cheap' doc-claim is verbatim across every extension-client's SessionClient (canonical mail-client mod.rs and all 6 siblings carry the same wording). The downstream contract is owned by jmap-base-client's JmapClient. Fix (downgrade the doc-claim to 'Clone forwards to JmapClient::clone()' + a separate canary test or compile-time bound in base-client) lands canonical-first.
